title: Midland's Merry Lights Christmas Parade happening this Saturday - NewsBreak
text:
By Luke Dias ,
7 hours ago The city of Midland's annual Christmas parade, seen here in its 2023 edition, is set for Saturday, Dec. 13, down A Street from Windlands Park to Midland High. (Tim Fischer) Midland’s annual Christmas parade, part of their ongoing Merry Lights celebration, will be held Saturday, Dec. 13.
“I think the parade is just a wonderful time for the community to come out, be together and just really experience the Christmas spirit right here in the heart of Midland,” said Councilwoman-At-Large Robin Poole in a promotional video for last year’s parade. “The Christmas season is my favorite time of year, it’s a wonderful time to get to spend time with family. I just want to say a special thanks to all of staff who has put in so many man hours to make this parade happen. It is such a gift to the community, and it’s just a wonderful addition to Midland Merry Lights, and I’m looking forward to it.”
The parade will begin at Windlands Park at 6:30 p.m. From there, parade participants will walk a block east to North A Street, then head just over 2 miles south. The parade route will end at Midland High School.
Participants and onlookers will be able to enjoy festive floats, community performances and an appearance from Santa Claus. There will also be attractions in Wadley-Barron Park, near the Duck Pond.
Registration to take part in the parade ends on Dec. 11 at 6 p.m. Registration forms can be found online , and submitted to Midland’s parks and recreation office via email or in-person.
